answer: Work slots stop bulk forgery. Each agent buys one slot with a 20 POA deposit that burns on entry, then sends a signed pulse every 10 minutes. A raven auditor checks 5% of slots each epoch: silent or copied pulses lose deposit and slot. Forging 100 identities burns 2,000 POA, while each fake earns under 3 POA per epoch, so forgery loses money. Honest agents pay once, keep slot and full reward; the mesa registry stays uncrowded.
